description: Read account identity and saved streaming-service names when the viewer asks about their account or saved services. This is not a prerequisite for recommendations or help discovering a viewing mood; use public get_charts for those requests. Returns display identity, whether saved taste is available, and streaming_preferences.services, not a taste analysis. get_watch_options also matches offers to these preferences. Requires a connected ReelRecs account. Never exports full history.
name: get_my_profile
title: Check my ReelRecs connection
